description: This source file defines a static class 'DbConnectionFactory' responsible for caching and creating database connections using different provider factories based on provided invariants. It configures mappings for various database providers, loads the corresponding assemblies and types, and returns configured DbConnection objects.

classes.name: DbConnectionFactory
classes.description: A static class managing cache and creation of database connections via provider factories, supporting multiple database systems.

methods.name: GetFactory
methods.description: Retrieves and caches a DbProviderFactory based on the database invariant name, loading the corresponding assembly and type dynamically.

methods.name: CreateConnection
methods.description: Creates and returns a new DbConnection for the specified database invariant name and connection string.
